 bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Mamdouh Aly Hassan, accepted by

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required

Wear the personal safety and healthy protective 
 equipment as safety shoes, helmet ,. etc.

Transformer is isolated and earthed from three 
 sides is required .
Portable earth connected to high voltage side .
Safety helmet, safety belt etc

Complete tool set ( meager ,dielectric test ,T.R. 
 test and DC .R test )
Portable earth for discharging
Voltage indicator and ladder
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes
Grease treatment plant
Tack oil sample for oil analysis laboratory.

Clean all porcelain surfaces on all bushing and 
 check the oil level in transformer bushing and tank.
Check the transformer for oil leakage.

Check the bushing for oil leakage and porcelain 
 damage.

Check the color for silica gel and change it when 
 necessary.

Perform the transformer oil test and if the 
 dissolving gases is higher or laboratory results is low ,we must use m/c 
 filtering to filter and make vacuum to the transformer oil .
Check the oil level in the conservator.

Check the oil level in the top housing of the H.V 
 bushing.
Inspect the paint work.
Check function of buchholz relay.
Check the seating flange bolts for tightness
Check the four oil coolers
Check the transformer earthing circuit
Check the transformer fire circuit

Place the transformer into normal operation condition with annual schedule 
 coolers.

Power Stations
Technical Procedure
150 MVA (Generator 
 Transformer)
Introduction
This 
 document outlines the equipment inspection I1 which must be performed on an annually 
 bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The 
 transformer cooling type is OFAF
The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Mamdouh Aly Hassan, accepted by 
 general Director eng. Nagy Nageeb Saleh, and approved by eng . Mohamed Abdel 
 Basset head Sector of Aswan Dam 2 Hydraulic Power Station and 
 certified by eng. 
 Kamel Ragheb: HPGC MPIS coordinator.
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required
Wear the personal safety and healthy protective 
 equipment as safety shoes, helmet ,. etc.
Transformer is isolated and earthed from three 
 sides is required .
Portable earth connected to high voltage side .
Safety helmet, safety belt etc
Complete tool set ( meager ,dielectric test ,T.R. 
 test and DC .R test )
Portable earth for discharging
Voltage indicator and ladder
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes
Grease treatment plant
Tack oil sample for oil analysis laboratory.
Clean all porcelain surfaces on all bushing and 
 check the oil level in transformer bushing and tank.
Check the transformer for oil leakage.
Check the bushing for oil leakage and porcelain 
 damage.
Check the color for silica gel and change it when 
 necessary.
Perform the transformer oil test and if the 
 dissolving gases is higher or laboratory results is low ,we must use m/c 
 filtering to filter and make vacuum to the transformer oil .
Check the oil level in the conservator.
Check the oil level in the top housing of the H.V 
 bushing.
Inspect the paint work.
Check function of buchholz relay.
Check the seating flange bolts for tightness
Check the four oil coolers
Check the transformer earthing circuit
Check the transformer fire circuit
Place the transformer into normal operation condition with annual schedule 
 coolers.
Tests and Results
Dissipation Factor Test
by using HV tester, measure and record capacitance, dissipation factor % and 
compare these values with historical data.
Turns Ratio Test
Perform 
 ratio test in high voltage coil to LV1&LV2and compare reading to historical 
 data
Winding Resistance (D.C.R.)
Take and record winding resistance (D.C.R.) each 
 high voltage coil phase to neutral
Each low voltage coil phase to phase and compare 
 reading to historical data
